concerns.text: FR-000 requires verification of matching Participant IDs across *separate* datasets (composite‑dataset strategy). The current task list (T003‑T006) only handles ID overlap within a single downloaded file and never references a second dataset, leaving the composite‑dataset matching requirement uncovered.

SC-002 demands a measurable artifact that records total compute time for the whole pipeline. The CI tasks (T014, T015) enforce a runtime ceiling but do not produce a concrete file (e.g., `ci_runtime_total.json`) that the success criterion can inspect, so the criterion lacks traceable evidence.
